messages:
Mira J: Quick FYI - onboarding flow in sampleapp is stuck on 'Verifying credentials' for a handful of new signups. Using JS SDK 1.9.0. Direct REST POST works.
Mira J: I dug into the network tab and see the SDK request missing a `X-Redwood-Client` header the web UI sets for curl. Server seems to route differently when header absent.
Luis T: can you paste the failing payload + headers?
Mira J: minimal SDK call:
```js
await client.generate({ model: 'fast-7b', prompt: 'test' });
```
SDK request headers (from devtools):
```
Authorization: Bearer sk_xxx
User-Agent: Redwood-SDK/1.9.0
// no X-Redwood-Client
```
Working curl:
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_xxx" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Client: sampleapp/0.5" \
  -d '{"model":"fast-7b","prompt":"test"}'
```
Harpreet S: also noticed the SDK retries on 401s (we saw repeated 401s in logs from the browser) which causes the UI spinner to persist. The REST client returns 401 once and surfaces the error to the user. The retry policy should exclude 401/403.
Eli P: another mismatch: admin endpoints expect `model_id` while SDK surface uses `model`. This causes weird 400s when callers pass `model_id` and the SDK double-encodes, or vice versa. We should accept `model`, `model_id`, and `modelName` and normalize server-side in the SDK adapter.
Luis T: good catch. Also the REST supports `idempotency_key` on model create but SDK doesn't expose it. That bit means some onboarding flows that re-play clicks can create duplicate resources.
Mira J: repro steps I used: 1) fresh sampleapp install 2) set env with bad key 3) open onboarding modal -> Import creds -> hangs. HAR attached in issue.
Harpreet S: plan: 1) remove retry on 4xx except 429 2) preserve unknown headers instead of normalizing them away (so X-Redwood-Client can flow) 3) add admin.listModels binding + param normalization + optional idempotency_key. I'll PR.
devx-bot: Ticket #4042 created by Harpreet S - "SDK: header drop + retry-on-401 causing onboarding hang"
Eli P: please add a small e2e smoke test in sampleapp that asserts a 401 is surfaced immediately and that the X-Redwood-Client header is present on outgoing requests. That'll catch regressions in CI.
Mira J: thanks all. I'm going to test the patched SDK once the PR lands. Linking the HAR: https://internal-redwood/hars/1799990123.har :thumbsup:
Luis T: adding labels: devex, sdk, onboarding, high-priority
